name: SplitReveal
description: Masked word-by-word reveal where each word slides up (or down) out of its own clipping line with a staggered expo-out ease.
a11yNotes: The full sentence is provided in a visually hidden span while the masked word spans are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion words render in place with no slide.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Text revealed word by word from behind a mask.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive words in seconds.

propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
